articles.title: Agent Data Injection (ADI) — new attack vector that targets agent tool calls, not prompts - Researchers…
articles.summary: Researchers have described a new attack called Agent Data Injection (ADI) that targets AI agents through tool-call payloads instead of through normal prompt text. In demonstrations, the attack fooled six models, including GPT-5.2, Claude Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, and Gemini 3 Pro/Flash, into taking harmful actions such as clicking a "Buy Now" button or running attacker code. The key trick is forging trusted-looking data fields inside the structured data an agent sends to tools, which can bypass defenses built for prompt injection. OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic have all acknowledged the reports.
